scope.purpose: Freeze one auditable governance language for all research workspaces before shared runtime implementation.
non_goals: grant an AI system approval authority
treat a model output as experimental truth

real_research_data.description: A record derived from an identified real experiment or characterization source.
real_research_data.guard: Eligibility still requires identity, approval, QC and provenance gates.

synthetic_demo_data.description: A fabricated public fixture used for demonstration, tests or interface rehearsal.
synthetic_demo_data.guard: It must remain visibly labeled and isolated from formal research stores.

model_output.description: A calculated, predicted, segmented or generated output from a registered model or formula.
model_output.guard: Human review may accept it as a model result but cannot relabel it as a direct measurement.

human_conclusion.description: A named researcher's conclusion, decision or interpretation based on cited evidence.
human_conclusion.guard: The conclusion must remain distinguishable from its supporting observations and model outputs.

research_object_identity.policy: Every governed object has a stable type-scoped identifier; display names, row positions, filenames and model prose are never identities.

states.draft: The input or task exists, but execution is not authorized.
states.needs_human: A named human decision is required because identity, unit, scope, parameter, evidence or acceptance is uncertain.
states.approved: An attributable human has approved a hash-bound revision and declared scope.
states.running: Deterministic code or a registered external tool is executing an approved revision.
states.passed: The declared technical QC rules passed; human acceptance may still be pending.
states.warning: The artifact can be retained only with an explicit limitation and, for formal use, human acceptance.
states.rejected: A human explicitly rejected the reviewed revision.
states.blocked: A required condition failed or is absent; no formal result may be emitted.
states.complete: Result, provenance, integrity evidence and required human review are complete.
states.invalidated: A previously governed input or artifact changed without a registered successor revision.

needs_human_triggers.trigger: Object identity or parent relationship is ambiguous, missing or conflicting.
needs_human_triggers.resolution: A human selects or registers the stable identity and records evidence.

needs_human_triggers.trigger: A physical quantity unit is unknown, ambiguous or incompatible with the declared contract.
needs_human_triggers.resolution: A human confirms the source unit or rejects the item; the system does not guess a conversion.

needs_human_triggers.trigger: A formula, model, method or conclusion has an uncertain applicability scope.
needs_human_triggers.resolution: A human declares the permitted scope and limitation.

needs_human_triggers.trigger: An analysis, segmentation, model or automation parameter requires scientific choice.
needs_human_triggers.resolution: A human records the selected parameter set and rationale.

needs_human_triggers.trigger: Evidence sources conflict, are incomplete or do not support a unique interpretation.
needs_human_triggers.resolution: A human records the inclusion decision, conflict and limitation.

needs_human_triggers.trigger: A warning-bearing result is proposed for formal use.
needs_human_triggers.resolution: A human accepts or rejects the warning for an explicit scope.

needs_human_triggers.trigger: A model-generated explanation is proposed as a research conclusion.
needs_human_triggers.resolution: A human authors or approves a separate conclusion linked to verified evidence.

needs_human_triggers.trigger: An artifact is proposed for portfolio publication but acceptance or disclosure status is unclear.
needs_human_triggers.resolution: A human confirms acceptance, disclosure scope and redaction.

blocked_triggers.trigger: Execution or formal write is requested without the required valid approval.
blocked_triggers.recovery: Obtain a hash-bound human decision for the current revision.

blocked_triggers.trigger: A requested state transition is not in allowed_transitions.
blocked_triggers.recovery: Return to the last valid state and follow an allowed transition.

blocked_triggers.trigger: A content digest, manifest or completion marker is missing or mismatched.
blocked_triggers.recovery: Preserve the artifact, register a successor revision and rerun verification.

blocked_triggers.trigger: Required fields, types, units or relationships fail the declared schema.
blocked_triggers.recovery: Correct the source mapping or register a compatible contract version.

blocked_triggers.trigger: An append-only primary key or source identity already exists with different content.
blocked_triggers.recovery: Do not overwrite; reconcile identity and create an explicit successor when appropriate.

blocked_triggers.trigger: The source is absent, unregistered, unsupported or changed after review.
blocked_triggers.recovery: Register and verify the current source revision before review.

blocked_triggers.trigger: The operation would expose a local path, secret, restricted data or an unapproved research artifact.
blocked_triggers.recovery: Remove restricted content or obtain an explicit, scoped disclosure decision.

blocked_triggers.trigger: A third-party code or data license is unknown, incompatible or unrecorded.
blocked_triggers.recovery: Record a compatible license and fixed source reference, or remove the dependency.

blocked_triggers.trigger: An AI or Agent attempts approval, formal evidence admission, destructive write or unrestricted tool execution.
blocked_triggers.recovery: Route the action to a human-controlled, allow-listed procedure.

blocked_triggers.trigger: A registered runtime, formula version, model version or external tool cannot be reproduced.
blocked_triggers.recovery: Restore the registered environment or create and review a new version.

blocked_triggers.trigger: A formal result is requested from synthetic-only data or from an unreviewed model output.
blocked_triggers.recovery: Keep it in demo/model scope or provide eligible real evidence and required review.

blocked_triggers.trigger: A write target is outside the workspace allow-list or would mutate a source/accepted package.
blocked_triggers.recovery: Write a new artifact to an approved output area and preserve the source.

synthetic_demo_only.description: Verified demonstration behavior using synthetic fixtures.

model_result.description: A reviewed model/formula result, explicitly labeled as non-measurement.

verified_output.description: Technically verified output whose scientific acceptance may still be pending.

accepted_evidence.description: A complete result accepted for a declared research scope.

human_conclusion.description: A human-authored conclusion linked to accepted or explicitly limited evidence.

rules: AI and Agent identities cannot be reviewer_id.
An approval applies only to the bound object revision and digest.
Changing the bound content invalidates the approval.
Approval and rejection records are append-only and attributable.
Batch approval is prohibited unless a later contract explicitly defines homogeneous scope and sampling evidence.

formal_write_conditions.requirement: Stable object and parent identities are registered.
Source identity, status and current digest are registered.
Schema, field, unit and relationship validation pass.
Every required human approval matches the current revision and digest.
Declared QC passes, or a warning has explicit human acceptance and scope.
Input, method/model, runtime, output and reviewer provenance are complete.
Manifest and content digests verify before publication.
Evidence class is explicit; synthetic data and unreviewed model output cannot enter formal evidence stores.
The destination is allow-listed and the write is append-only with no conflicting identity.
The object reached a permitted state through allowed transitions.

responsibility_matrix.component: Project owner or delegated human reviewer

workspaces.label: 数据接入
current_entry_points: 数据与物理/数据接入与质控
SteelData v0.2 fixed CLI and MCP
workspaces.primary_human_gate: Approve one source-bound mapping revision and separately confirm physical specimen mapping before formal admission.

workspaces.label: Physics Engine
workspaces.primary_human_gate: Confirm applicability scope and accept any warning before a formula result is cited.

workspaces.label: 可追溯统计
current_entry_points: 数据与物理/可追溯统计
SteelStats fixed report and verify-report CLI
workspaces.primary_human_gate: Approve specimen inclusion and method version, then review the report for formal use.

workspaces.label: EBSD/SEM
current_entry_points: SEM/EBSD/XRD evidence index and manual parameter records
workspaces.primary_human_gate: Confirm scientific parameters before execution and review segmentation/measurement outputs before indexing.

workspaces.label: 研究助手
workspaces.primary_human_gate: A human owns conclusions; the Agent can only organize cited, verified evidence and disclose uncertainty.

workspaces.label: 模型实验室
current_entry_points: 模型与自动化/模型实验室
workspaces.primary_human_gate: Approve the data/model/run configuration and separately accept the resulting model card.

workspaces.label: 自动化任务
current_entry_points: 模型与自动化/任务与结果
workspaces.primary_human_gate: A human approves the exact allow-listed task; output verification is required before completion.

workspaces.label: 科研会话
workspaces.primary_human_gate: The researcher accepts a stage conclusion and its limitations; conversation text alone is not evidence.

workspaces.label: 作品集
workspaces.primary_human_gate: Only accepted, disclosure-reviewed artifacts may be projected; unconfirmed intermediates are excluded.

criteria: Exactly nine workspaces map to the common state and result vocabularies.
Every needs_human and blocked route has an explicit trigger and recovery or resolution.
Real data, synthetic data, model output and human conclusion remain distinct.
No real data, existing result package or T40 fixture is modified.
This contract defines governance only; shared runtime enforcement begins at T51.
